items.question: Who is identified as the best husband, foremost lord of progeny, son of Marici, and chief?
premises: prajeśa agryo means foremost lord of progeny
marīci janaka agraṇīḥ means born of Marici and chief
items.inference: The verse names a figure by these combined epithets.
uncertainties: exact syntactic relation among the epithets is not fully resolved
prajeśa may be a compound member rather than standalone genitive
items.plain_english: Best husband, foremost lord of progeny, born of Marici, and chief.
